terms.grammar: noun, first declension; also māteriēs, māteriēī f. (nom. and acc. sing.)
evidence: Cic. N.D. 3.92: māteria rērum, ex quā et in quā sunt omnia (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: What a thing is made of. Of trees it is timber for building, as against ligna, firewood; it is also the subject matter of a speech or a book (see subject). For a chemical see chemical.

phrases.latin: Ex quā māteriā facta est haec pila?
phrases.english: What is this ball made of?
